svg.title: Five Routes, Explicit Denominators
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-unit-contribution-by-lane; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Routes, Explicit Denominators; subtitle: Illustrative contribution percentages, not interchangeable annual returns.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Each bar uses $10,000 of its stated purchase, invoice, or treasury principal as denominator. Wholesale and rewards bars cover one transaction cycle; treasury covers 55 days. These examples are not components of the annual scorecard bridge. All prices, reward rates, and payment fees below are modeling inputs rather than current provider quotations.; caption: Keep wholesale spread, reward contribution, and treasury yield separate. Negative fee-versus-rebate transactions cannot be improved merely by increasing payment volume.; stages: label: Insured electronics wholesale; value: 2.40% — $240 contribution per $10,000 purchase; numeric value: 2.4; detail: A pre-committed $10,300 reimbursement less $10,000 merchandise and $60 insured outbound shipping leaves $240 before shared overhead. Exclude card and portal rewards from this wholesale-only calculation.; label: Commodity wholesale replenishment; value: 0.80% — $80 contribution per $10,000 purchase; numeric value: 0.8; detail: A $10,200 reimbursement less $10,000 merchandise, $80 shipping, and $40 expected deductions leaves $80 before overhead. A further $100 receiving shortfall turns the order contribution negative.; label: Eligible card and portal stack; value: 3.00% — $300 incremental rewards per $10,000 spend; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Assume $200 collectible card rewards plus $100 collectible portal rewards and zero incremental payment fee. Verify Rakuten or TopCashback attribution, reseller eligibility, and card terms. Test claimed uncapped 2%–4% offers rather than assuming availability.; label: B2B invoice payment rail; value: −0.90% — $90 loss per $10,000 invoice; numeric value: -0.9; detail: An illustrative Plastiq or Melio route earns $200 at 2% of eligible invoice spend but costs $290 at a 2.9% fee. The $90 deficit precedes interest and overhead; verify rail and issuer eligibility separately.; label: Settled cash treasury placement; value: 0.603% — about $60.27 per $10,000 over 55 days; numeric value: 0.6027397260273972; detail: Use $10,000 × 4% × 55/365 for a simple-interest planning estimate before fees and taxes. Actual T-bill return follows purchase price and maturity proceeds. Exclude bank bonuses until qualification and exclude borrowed card principal from profit.

rect.title: label: Insured electronics wholesale; value: 2.40% — $240 contribution per $10,000 purchase; numeric value: 2.4; detail: A pre-committed $10,300 reimbursement less $10,000 merchandise and $60 insured outbound shipping leaves $240 before shared overhead. Exclude card and portal rewards from this wholesale-only calculation.

label: Commodity wholesale replenishment; value: 0.80% — $80 contribution per $10,000 purchase; numeric value: 0.8; detail: A $10,200 reimbursement less $10,000 merchandise, $80 shipping, and $40 expected deductions leaves $80 before overhead. A further $100 receiving shortfall turns the order contribution negative.

label: Eligible card and portal stack; value: 3.00% — $300 incremental rewards per $10,000 spend; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Assume $200 collectible card rewards plus $100 collectible portal rewards and zero incremental payment fee. Verify Rakuten or TopCashback attribution, reseller eligibility, and card terms. Test claimed uncapped 2%–4% offers rather than assuming availability.

label: B2B invoice payment rail; value: −0.90% — $90 loss per $10,000 invoice; numeric value: -0.9; detail: An illustrative Plastiq or Melio route earns $200 at 2% of eligible invoice spend but costs $290 at a 2.9% fee. The $90 deficit precedes interest and overhead; verify rail and issuer eligibility separately.

label: Settled cash treasury placement; value: 0.603% — about $60.27 per $10,000 over 55 days; numeric value: 0.6027397260273972; detail: Use $10,000 × 4% × 55/365 for a simple-interest planning estimate before fees and taxes. Actual T-bill return follows purchase price and maturity proceeds. Exclude bank bonuses until qualification and exclude borrowed card principal from profit.

text.title: Assumptions: Each bar uses $10,000 of its stated purchase, invoice, or treasury principal as denominator. Wholesale and rewards bars cover one transaction cycle; treasury covers 55 days. These examples are not components of the annual scorecard bridge. All prices, reward rates, and payment fees below are modeling inputs rather than current provider quotations.
